justification.text: `1 / Real.exp 1` is the constant 1/e of the informal (1 − 1/e)p; Real.exp 1 = e > 0, so the denominator is never zero.

`k.factorial % p` is the problem's k! (mod p) for p prime, because the limit is taken along `Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {p | p.Prime}`, so only prime p (hence p ≥ 2) contribute to the statement; the modulus is never zero where the statement speaks.

`↑(Finset.image (fun k => k.factorial % p) (Finset.Ico 1 p)).card / ↑p` is the problem's |A_p|/p, because along the filter p is prime and so p ≥ 2 > 0; the division is in ℝ and the denominator is never zero where the statement speaks.
`Finset.Ico 1 p` is the problem's range 1 ≤ k < p in A_p = {k! mod p : 1 ≤ k < p} as the informal text states it; the lower endpoint is included and the upper excluded, exactly as written.

theorem Opn.erdos_478 :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun p : ℕ =>
        (((Finset.Ico 1 p).image (fun k => Nat.factorial k % p)).card : ℝ) / p)
      (Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {p : ℕ | p.Prime})
      (nhds (1 - 1 / Real.exp 1)) := by
  sorry
